summary_1line: Dhritarashtra urges peace and warns of Pandava strength, but Duryodhana defiantly vows war, framing battle as a sacrificial ritual he will perform with Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands in armor beside Karna, proclaiming the coming war as a sacrifice with his chariot as the altar and arrows as sacred grass.
Blind king Dhritarashtra raises his hands in despair as he foretells Bhima crushing elephants and the Kaurava army like hills split on the battlefield.
Dhrishtadyumna boldly addresses the court, declaring he will face Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and the gathered kings like a shore resisting the swelling sea.
